title: Apollo 13 zapped because of a nuclear device

tellings.quote: I found out um that um Apollo 13 may not have failed by a mechanical problem. It may have been zapped by the aliens because they may have had a nuclear warhead on board.

plain: Apollo 13, the 1970 Moon mission that nearly ended in disaster, may not have failed because of a mechanical problem but because aliens zapped it, since it may have carried a nuclear warhead, says a scientist named Steve Colbern. He tells Michels he found this out, linking it to the Atomic Energy Commission, and if true it would mean aliens act to stop nuclear weapons going into space.
